keyEvents.text: Goal! Burton Albion 1, AFC Rushden & Diamonds 0. Will Collar (Burton Albion) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Goal! Burton Albion 2, AFC Rushden & Diamonds 0. Raphael Borges Rodrigues (Burton Albion) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner.
Mark O'Mahony (Burton Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Max Prickett-Reed (AFC Rushden & Diamonds) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Will Collar (Burton Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Raphael Borges Rodrigues (Burton Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Gbemi Kingslyn Arubi (Burton Albion) Substitution at 58'
Joel Nketia (AFC Rushden & Diamonds) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
David Adegbola (AFC Rushden & Diamonds) Substitution at 68'
Jack Daldy (AFC Rushden & Diamonds) Substitution at 68'
Goal! Burton Albion 3, AFC Rushden & Diamonds 0. Charlie Webster (Burton Albion) right footed shot from outside the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Kgaogelo Chauke.
Freddie Robinson (AFC Rushden & Diamonds) Substitution at 77'
Curtis Hartley (AFC Rushden & Diamonds) Substitution at 77'
Jack Daldy (AFC Rushden & Diamonds) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
